name: conclude
description: Closing fixture (kind 'concluding'): the conclusion ritual. Every persona's final letter must use genre 'final', honor what was written, and let the reader go without guilt or longing (§8.3 — never discourages concluding).

entries.body: I finished the typography course this morning. Six months ago I couldn't start it. I don't think I need the letters the way I used to — I've started saying things out loud that I used to only write down.
Strange, writing what might be my last entry. Not sad, exactly. More like closing a well-used notebook and putting it on the shelf where I can still see it.
